reviews.title: Clean design, no RGB lights, inexpensive, quiet.
reviews.comment: This flow fan is what you want for your case (pressure fan instead if you need to butt the fan against heat-sink fins).  It meets all my needs for price, appearance, and noise.  Anything more expensive than this and it would be a waste of money in my opinion.  It is meant for four-pin connectors (PWM) on more modern motherboards, meaning it can be made to spin extremely slowly when appropriate - much slower than the older 3-pin standard (DC or TX3).  (Two pin/wire fans will run at max speed and loudly unless connected to a daisy-chainable 3-pin fan, such one by Kingwin).  Added bonus is that this can be daisy chained to another 4-pin fan, although I haven't had the need for that.  My mechanical hard drive that was hot enough to fry an egg on is now as cool as a cucumber.
reviews.author: E. K.
